task: Make large default lattice CLI outputs brief by default so agent loops stop re-paying them on every subsequent model call, while an explicit flag and a LATTICE_BRIEF_OUTPUT=0 env escape hatch restore the full output, and explicit --json/--format=json machine shapes stay frozen.
outcome: Bare invocations of milestone_status (and the milestone suffix appended after mutating commands like story_advance), finding_list, help, story_list, and global bug_list emit compact actionable summaries (counts + next action + one-liners) instead of multi-KB dumps; a full-output flag per command and LATTICE_BRIEF_OUTPUT=0 restore verbose output; a smoke test enforces size budgets and contract stability; gate behavior and gateEvidence semantics unchanged.
